svg.aria-label: Three animated robotics simulations: DWA local planner rollouts, reactive replanning with kinematic redundancy on a UR12e, and a quadruped trot gait
svg.title: The Lab
svg.desc: Left: a DWA local planner samples 15 velocity rollouts, scores them and commits to the lowest-cost arc. Middle: a UR12e holds a fixed end-effector pose while switching between two IK solutions on the elbow self-motion circle to dodge an obstacle. Right: a 12-axis quadruped walking a trot gait.

g.text: one EE pose · many arm solutions
MIT Cheetah-derived · trot gait · SLAM in Gazebo
12 AXES · ROS 2 · IRL DEMOS -> UNITREE GO2
